 November 2, 2026 Facebook X Linkedin Email Print Courtesy of the Wynne School District. WYNNE — Wynne High School will hold its annual Financial Aid Night tonight, starting at 6 p.m.
 It will be held in the library on the temporary high school campus.
 Students and parents will be able to create their FSA ID and apply for financial aid through the FAFSA website. Representatives with UAEACC will also provide updated financial aid information.
 Families are asked to bring a charged Chromebook and know the Social Security number, legal name as it appears on the Social Security card and date of birth for both the student and parent, as well as a personal email address and cell phone number.
 For questions, email pparkman@wynneschools.org .
